definitions.gloss: light gray; pale gray; ash gray
definitions.explanation: A muted, pale shade of gray. Used to describe colors in fashion, design, interior decoration, and nature. Formed with the prefix 薄 (light, thin) added to 灰色 (gray).

examples.japanese: {薄灰色|うすはいいろ}のセーターを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a light gray sweater.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}が{薄灰色|うすはいいろ}に{曇|くも}っている。
examples.english: The sky is overcast in a pale gray.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}を{薄灰色|うすはいいろ}に{塗|ぬ}ると、{部屋|へや}が{広|ひろ}く{感|かん}じられる。
examples.english: If you paint the walls light gray, the room feels more spacious.

notes:
Composed of {薄|うす} (light, pale) and {灰色|はいいろ} (gray). Part of the productive {薄|うす}～ color pattern where {薄|うす} lightens any base color.

COLOR SHADE PATTERN:
- {薄|うす}～: light/pale version ({薄青|うすあお}, {薄緑|うすみどり}, {薄紫|うすむらさき})
- {濃|こ}い～: dark version ({濃|こ}い{灰色|はいいろ}, {濃|こ}い{青|あお})

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄灰色|うすはいいろ}の{空|そら}: pale gray sky
- {薄灰色|うすはいいろ}のスーツ: light gray suit
- {薄灰色|うすはいいろ}に{染|そ}める: to dye light gray

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {灰色|はいいろ}: gray — the standard neutral gray
- {濃灰色|のうはいいろ}: dark gray — the darker counterpart
- {銀色|ぎんいろ}: silver — a metallic gray with sheen, whereas {薄灰色|うすはいいろ} is matte
